prompts.name: project-brief
prompts.prompt: Create one premium editorial photograph for a custom commercial sign website process page. Landscape 4:3, 1536x1152. Show an orderly designer's light oak desk photographed at a gentle overhead angle in natural warm daylight. Central white artwork sheet with the EXACT custom logo from attached reference: black angular A monogram beside 'ATELIER' and secondary 'DESIGN STUDIO'. Beside the artwork: one small photograph print showing the attached pale stone wall with black dimensional ATELIER sign, another small photograph of a clean empty reception wall, a simple hand-drawn overall width measurement on tracing paper, a metal ruler and a graphite pencil. The artwork and location photographs are the dominant subjects, not office objects. Sparse, tactile, quietly professional, warm white, charcoal and pale wood palette. Every paper has generous margins. No people, hands, laptop, phone, screen UI, website UI, decorative text, email addresses, dates, certification marks, APPROVED stamps or client/order numbers. This illustrates information a customer can provide, and must look like a carefully composed brand planning reference rather than evidence of an actual customer order. Attach image is a visual reference for the fictional ATELIER sign and material palette, do not simply reproduce the photograph as the whole output.

prompts.name: specification-review
prompts.prompt: Create one premium editorial process photograph, 4:3 landscape 1536x1152, for a custom commercial sign specification-review web page. Reference image establishes fictional ATELIER angular A monogram, black unlit metal dimensional letters, pale stone and warm daylight. Photograph an elegant real paper sign specification example on a pale grey studio worktop, modest near-overhead angle with crisp readable design drawings. A large central sheet shows the entire ATELIER / DESIGN STUDIO logo as a clean front elevation, an overall horizontal dimension labelled '1800 mm', a vertical dimension labelled '420 mm', and a small side-section labelled '30 mm'. Include three discreet print labels only: 'ARTWORK', 'FINISH', 'MOUNTING'. Along the sheet's lower edge place an actual matte-black metal finish swatch and one small unlit black metal letter section with visible dimensional return plus two fixing studs, carefully spaced. One narrow material sample strip in warm bronze may sit beside the black sample to suggest comparison. Include a neatly resting graphite pencil. Beautiful quiet composition; plenty of clean paper around drawing; no people, hand, computers, screens, industrial clutter, branding besides ATELIER, client data, order IDs, approval stamps, certificates, dates, glow or illuminated letters. Drawing is a conceptual visual aid, not an engineering approval or authentic production document. The artwork should be coherent at thumbnail size, diagram and material samples must dominate. No website UI or screenshot frame.
